concrete_increment: Explicit observationally equivalent complete-excluder-mixture and universal-partial-reliance models correct Sekine's inference from three reported verdict rates to some successful excluders, preserving his conceptual defence. General statistical method and basing distinctions are inherited.
closest_overlap: Wittlin 2023 pp.1759–60 n.143 already distinguishes discounting/discarding, statistical caution and improper bases. Hoeft et al. 2025 already test process-sensitive information acquisition. Neither accessed text supplies this exact countermodel to Sekine.
limitations: Bounded indexed search; no universal priority claim. Sekine/Wittlin target passages and Hoeft excerpts directly read. Rocchè/Wang full texts and original Wistrich experiment/raw data not read. Model-to-basing mapping requires care, especially reasons weighed against conviction. Compatibility alone does not eliminate probabilistic evidence.
